title: Bipartite Turán problem on cographs
summary: A cograph is a graph that contains no induced path $P_4$ on four vertices or equivalently a graph that can be constructed from vertices by sum and product operations. We study the bipartite Turán problem restricted to cographs: for fixed integers $s \leq t$, what is the maximum number of edges in an $n$-vertex cograph that does not contain $K_{s,t}$ as a subgraph? This problem falls within the framework of induced Turán numbers $\text{ex}(n, \{K_{s,t}, P_4\text{-ind}\})$ introduced by Loh, Tait, Timmons, and Zhou.
